description: Baseline AI judge scores for regression testing. Synthetic model analysis responses with known Likert scores. Used to mock ModelAnalysisJudge and verify grading pipeline stability.

baselines.analysis_text: Two HIGH-severity issues require immediate attention before this model is used in investment decisions. First, the balance sheet in BS!D40 shows a $42M imbalance (total assets $1,240M vs. liabilities + equity $1,198M) — this must be resolved before any valuation analysis is credible. Second, the terminal growth rate in DCF!B15 is hardcoded to 3% in a formula cell; move this to an input cell (e.g., Assumptions!B5) and reference it. Additionally, DCF!B8 has WACC hardcoded as 8.5% — reference the Assumptions tab. The external Bloomberg reference in Comps!F12 will break if the source file is unavailable; embed or document the dependency. Prioritization: fix BS imbalance first (integrity), then DCF hardcodes (sensitivity analysis requires live inputs), then external reference (operational).
